caption: The drawing depicts a round, lidded vessel resembling a pot or tureen, positioned centrally against a plain, off-white background within a rectangular frame. The vessel is rendered in shades of brown and dark brown, with subtle highlights suggesting its material has a slightly reflective, possibly ceramic or metallic surface. The pot has two small, outward-curving handles on either side and a knob on the top of the lid for lifting. The body features two horizontal ridges encircling the form, one near the top and one near the middle. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller detailed inset, showing a close-up view of one of the handles against a similarly shaded brown background. The signature "N. Amantea" is written at the bottom right corner within the border.
title: Sugar Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
